scope: Original E14 simulator checkpoint replay and real-input export audit; no packed inference or timing claim.

content.checkpoint: one bf16 fake-quantized state file per decoder layer

fold.norm: all RMSNorm affine weights fused into consumer weights then set to one
fold.official_bug_avoided: official head calls rotate_embeddings twice; E14 applies algebraic R1 once
fold.r1: global residual rotation; input rows WQ, residual output Q^T W
fold.r2: per-head V rotation with identical fold into every GQA-expanded o_proj head block
fold.r3: QuaRot cross-head Hadamard at o_proj for Hadamard rows; omitted for the specified NAR R1/R2/R4 rows
fold.r4: per-layer down-input rotation folded into down_proj rows
